mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.serial_number, e.patient_id, p.name AS patient_name, p.gender, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, p.birth_date, CURDATE()) AS age, p.phone AS phone_number, p.disease_type, e.followup_plan_id, pl.plan_name AS followup_plan_name, e.followup_project_id, pm.project_name AS followup_project, e.followup_team, e.primary_doctor, e.health_manager, e.application_time, e.enrollment_time, e.followup_status, e.enrollment_remark, e.created_time, e.updated_time, e.created_by, e.updated_by FROM followup_patient_enrollment e LEFT JOIN patient p ON e.patient_id = p.id LEFT JOIN followup_plan_repository pl ON e.followup_plan_id = pl.id LEFT JOIN followup_program_master pm ON e.followup_project_id = pm.id WHERE e.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO followup_patient_enrollment ( serial_number, patient_id, followup_plan_id, followup_project_id, followup_team, primary_doctor, health_manager, application_time, enrollment_time, followup_status, enrollment_remark, created_by, created_time, updated_time ) VALUES ( #{serial_number}, #{patient_id}, #{followup_plan_id}, #{followup_project_id}, #{followup_team}, #{primary_doctor}, #{health_manager}, #{application_time}, #{enrollment_time}, #{followup_status}, #{enrollment_remark}, #{created_by}, #{created_time}, #{updated_time} )
